title: 'Change is necessary' - players unite against Fifa
summary: Current and former footballers have united against FIFA president Gianni Infantino, calling for change at the global governing body. The unified stance reflects growing discontent with leadership at the organization.
content: A number of current and former footballers unite against Fifa president Gianni Infantino, stating that "change is necessary" at the global governing body.

zh.title: "变革是必要的" - 球员联合反对国际足联
zh.summary: 现任和前足球运动员已经联合反对国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺，呼吁改革这个全球管理机构。这一统一立场反映了对该组织领导层日益增长的不满。

title: Grealish back for Man City - but for how long?
summary: Manchester City winger Jack Grealish has returned to action with two substitute appearances this season, but questions remain about his long-term future at the club. Uncertainty surrounds his role and playing time moving forward.
content: Man City winger has made two substitute appearances so far this season, but his future remains in doubt.

zh.title: 格雷利什重返曼城 - 但能待多久？
zh.summary: 曼城边锋杰克·格雷利什本赛季以两次替补出场的形式重返赛场，但关于他在俱乐部的长期前景仍存疑问。他的角色和上场时间前景不确定。

title: Flex your football brain with our daily quizzes
summary: BBC Football offers daily interactive quizzes including 'Who Am I?', 'Five in Five', and 'Brainteaser' to test football knowledge. The quizzes provide fans an engaging way to challenge their understanding of the sport.
content: Test your ball knowledge against today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser.

zh.title: 用我们的每日测验展示你的足球知识
zh.summary: 英国广播公司足球频道提供每日互动测验，包括"我是谁？"、"五选五"和"脑筋急转弯"来测试足球知识。这些测验为球迷提供了一个有趣的方式来挑战他们对这项运动的理解。
